basic_profile.bio: Avid reader and comic book enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. Recently got into the e-reader scene and loving the convenience of my Kindle. I work as a graphic designer for a local publishing company, which fuels my passion for visual storytelling. In my free time, I enjoy exploring local hiking trails and experimenting with vegan recipes. Typically online in the evenings after work and during weekends. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to focus on personal growth and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design and have been working in the publishing industry for a few years. My interest in technology and gadgets is mainly self-taught, often through trial and error and online forums. I love staying updated on the latest e-reader technologies and exploring new ways to consume digital content.
